summary.text: Mike Barrett is a Democratic state senator who has represented the 3rd Middlesex District since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He also served in the Massachusetts State Senate from 1987 to 1994.

paragraphs.text: Mike Barrett earned a bachelor's degree from Harvard College and a law degree from Northeastern University School of Law.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as IT, health care and government.
Barrett assumed his current Senate seat on January 2, 2013, returning to a chamber in which he had served from 1987 to 1994.

In 2025-2026 he chairs the Telecommunications, Utilities and Energy Joint Committee, is vice chair of the Senate Global Warming and Climate Change Committee, and also sits on the joint committees on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet, and Cybersecurity and on Tourism, Arts and Cultural Development.
